description: Revert create, edit, replace_text, patch, move, or delete calls by undo id or the newest N calls. Use when a change made by this server must be reverted. Do not use for outside changes or expired ids; rewrite those with `edit` or `create`. Preview with dryRun, which lists ids. A path changed since that call is skipped while the rest revert; it stays under its id for a retry. The in-memory journal keeps up to 64 calls for 30 minutes, fewer when FS_MAX_UNDO_BYTES fills. No redo. Unknown ids fail NOT_FOUND. Returns steps[] of {id, tool, results[]}, each path restored or with an error code. A long list is cut (failures kept), marked truncated with totalResults. Errors only if every path fails.

dryRun.description: Preview without changing anything. With no id or steps, previews every journaled call and lists their ids.

id.description: Undo id from a mutating tool result. Required over HTTP, where all clients share the journal.

steps.description: Revert the newest N calls, newest first. Not with id; rejected over HTTP. Omit both to revert the newest call.

name: undo
title: Undo
